links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT and ASRM patient materials versus recommended reading level
links.effect: Readability of both ChatGPT and ASRM materials exceeded recommended levels for patient proficiency across six readability formulas, with AI-based material scored as more complex.
links.quote: Readability scores for both ChatGPT and ASRM materials were found to exceed recommended levels for patient proficiency across six readability formulas, with AI-based material scored as more complex.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education content relative to patient proficiency
links.effect: ChatGPT and ASRM materials both surpassed recommended reading levels across six readability scores; ChatGPT text was more complex.
links.quote: A readability analysis suggested that both materials sourced from ChatGPT and ASRM surpassed recommended reading levels across six readability scores.

screen.reason: Evaluates patient and surgeon preferences and readability for LLM-generated vs professional society patient education materials without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
